{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Giju sliders''' were the largest of the standard [[slider]]s on the menu at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The slider was inspired by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]]&mdash;the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]]&mdash;travels around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> Named after the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> the diner claimed the slider was able to satisfy a "Herglic&ndash;sized" hunger.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

It consisted of two [[Mongo Beefhead patty|Mongo Beefhead patties]], triple [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]], deep-fried [[Tapani triangle]]s, [[mega-leaf lettuce]], a slice of [[algae-bread]], [[Boontaspiced mustard]], [[plankton spread]], [[larded neutrino]]s and a fried [[blubberbird]] egg, all on a trans-shipped [[medium-density food-board]], with a [[green jumbolive]] on top. The diner charged 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the slider and served it with the diner's [[Slider garnish|special garnish]]. [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] were also available for the slider upon request. The Giju slider could also be bought alongside another basic slider as a [[Talus and Tralus slider]] meal at the diner.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Giju sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
